name: Capability Fabric
actions: validate a reviewed exact capability build request
resolve one digest-bound source-reviewed recipe or return a typed hold
bind a first-class HAND or SKILL kind through every build artifact
compile one detached complete capability candidate by default
emit focused tests without executing generated code
materialize exact Nursery-compatible candidates through explicit CLI or browser download
inspect future recipe proposals without activating them
expose exact inactive builder-review material for a closed object-contract adapter without making it buildable
bind every active recipe and candidate package to an exact modular builder implementation digest
plan bounded acyclic multi-capability graphs through exact consumes/provides contracts
build and verify detached composition bundles without executing any node
materialize every composed node with an exact composition receipt through explicit CLI only
summary: A deterministic Workshop how-layer that compiles reviewed recipes into detached HAND and SKILL candidates and binds them into bounded typed DAG compositions without ongoing model compute.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL only. Composition proves declared contract identity, acyclic order, package lineage, and resource bounds—not runtime payload semantics or host authority. One object-adapter builder is an inactive source-review candidate and cannot enter normal builds. No generated code execution, installation, promotion, Foundation, or CANON authority is granted.
